If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button

File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Add a catch handler to exportReport's promise chain in ExportButton.tsx to reset busy state to false when exports fail, preventing the button from remaining disabled permanently.
args.title: Fix stuck busy state on export failure in ExportButton

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton.tsx calls exportReport and handles success via .then(), but does not catch errors, leaving busy stuck at true (disabling the button) when exportReport rejects.
